items.title: UN Security Council Holds Emergency Session on Jammu & Kashmir
items.excerpt: An emergency session of the UN Security Council has been convened to discuss the escalating situation in Jammu & Kashmir.
items.author: News Desk

heroImage.caption: The UN Security Council in session on the question of Jammu & Kashmir.

body.text: The United Nations Security Council convened an emergency session today to address the rapidly deteriorating human rights and security situation in Jammu & Kashmir.
Diplomats from multiple countries called for restraint, dialogue, and adherence to international law, while human rights organisations urged the Council to prioritise civilian protection.

body.caption: Delegates arrive for the late‑evening emergency session in New York.

body.text: The session follows weeks of heightened tensions, communications restrictions, and reports of arbitrary detentions in the region.
